name: King's Hawaiian Original Hawaiian Sweet Rolls
whyItWorks: Iconic pillowy soft rolls baked from enriched wheat flour, real butter, and pure cane sugar. The cloud-like texture dissolves easily upon chewing, leaving virtually zero digestive residue in the small bowel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve warm by placing rolls in a 350°F oven for 2–3 minutes. Perfect for leftover turkey or roasted chicken sliders.
